note: Sanitized video-generation profiles for local Apple-Silicon inference. This is a third layer, separate from the oMLX text profiles (omlx-profiles.json) and the mflux image profiles (mflux-profiles.json): oMLX serves text LLMs, mflux the FLUX images, and these two tools the video models. No API keys or secrets included.

wan22-ti2v-5b-q8.name: wan22-ti2v-5b-q8
wan22-ti2v-5b-q8.description: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B, mixed q8/BF16 MLX-Gen package. Text- and image-to-video at up to 720P@24fps.
wan22-ti2v-5b-q8.cli_note: mlx-gen is installed on its own (a dedicated virtualenv), because its console scripts overlap mflux's and `uv tool install mlx-gen` refuses to overwrite them. Put that venv's bin directory on PATH before running: `export PATH="$HOME/Sites/.mlxgen-venv/bin:$PATH"`. The harness invokes `mlxgen` by name, so PATH is what selects it.
wan22-ti2v-5b-q8.license_note: Apache-2.0, inherited from the base model. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.
wan22-ti2v-5b-q8.settings_note: A conservative baseline chosen to fit a 64 GB M1 Max with --low-ram; it is NOT the uploader's validation profile (that was 1280x704, 17 frames, 20 steps on a 128 GB M5 Max, which peaked at ~104 GiB). TI2V-5B natively supports up to 121 frames; mlx-gen defaults single shots to 81. Adjust and record if a run needs a different canvas.

cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.name: cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8
cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.description: CogVideoX-Fun V1.5 5B InP, int8 MLX port by dgrauet. Text-to-video and video inpainting.
cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.repo_note: quick_infer.py lives in the cloned VideoX-Fun-mlx repository, not in this benchmark repo. Override with --repo.
cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.license: The CogVideoX License (the quant is tagged apache-2.0)
cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.license_note: The quant repository is tagged apache-2.0, but that tag does not apply: the base model (alibaba-pai/CogVideoX-Fun-V1.5-5b-InP) is under The CogVideoX License. Academic use is free; commercial use requires registering for a basic commercial licence and stays under 1M visits/month; military and illegal uses banned; governed by PRC law. The inference code (VideoX-Fun-mlx) is itself Apache-2.0. See docs/reference/LICENSES.md.
cogvideox-fun-1.5-5b-inp-q8.settings_note: quick_infer.py's own defaults (672x384, 5 frames, 50 steps, guidance 6.0). The script writes an animated GIF, so there is no fps flag; ffprobe reads the frame rate from the file. Note this is a 5th of a second at 24fps — the clip is short by design.
